chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah narrated from 'Ali ibn Shajarah, from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him: Our companions may be gathered together in one place, then some of them stand and perform the Zuhr prayer, while some of them perform the 'Asr prayer. He said: All of that is broad in allowance.

key_terms.أَصْحَابُنَا: our companions, meaning the Shi'a believers referred to in the report
key_terms.الْمَكَانِ: the place where people are gathered
key_terms.وَاسِعٌ: broad in allowance, indicating permissibility and latitude

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for some people to pray Zuhr while others pray 'Asr in the same gathering?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates flexibility regarding the time of Zuhr and 'Asr when companions are gathered together and some pray Zuhr while others pray 'Asr. The Imam عليه السلام states that all of this is permissible, pointing to breadth and allowance in the prayer time.
